data.name: Italika
data.gender_notes: Italika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Italika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'it' meaning joy and 'alika' meaning radiant or swift. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, and happiness. The name Italika carries the meaning “Joyful, radiant, or swift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Italika usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant, or swift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
